script_text: The stars are about to completely disrupt your love life in ways you cannot ignore. The weekend Moon in Capricorn ignites your 1st House, putting you center stage under Saturn's earthy rule. Friday is your power day because Venus forms a trine to Jupiter in a career-expanding transit. Monday remains your hardest day as the Mercury-Saturn square breeds miscommunication. Seize Friday's cosmic momentum for one bold career move. Follow for daily updates.
